title.en: U.S. BIS enforces remote-access export controls on AI chips and rescinds AI Diffusion Rule
title.zhHans: 美国商务部 BIS 生效先进 AI 芯片远程访问出口管制并正式废止 AI 扩散规则

searchSummary.en: Published and effective November 19, 2026 (91 FR 74970), BIS's interim final rule restricts overseas data centers from remotely supplying advanced U.S. AI compute to Country Group D:5 and Macau entities, adds five diversion-risk destinations, and formally rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 19 日正式刊登《联邦公报》并即期生效（91 FR 74970），美国商务部 BIS 临时最终规则限制海外数据中心向 D:5 国家组及澳门实体远程提供大规模先进 AI 算力，新增五国转运许可要求，并正式废止 2025 年 AI 扩散规则。

summary.en: On November 19, 2026, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) published and put into immediate effect its interim final rule 'Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors' (91 FR 74970, Document 2026-23529; released November 16). The rule adds EAR § 744.24 restricting exports, reexports, and transfers of advanced semiconductors to overseas data centers providing significant remote compute to entities headquartered (or with ultimate parents headquartered) in Country Group D:5 (including China) or Macau, adds license requirements for Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Brazil, tightens foundry/OSAT presumptions, and formally rescinds the January 2025 AI Diffusion Rule (90 FR 4544).
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 19 日，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）在《联邦公报》刊登并即期生效临时最终规则《应对先进半导体远程访问》（91 FR 74970，文件号 2026-23529；11 月 16 日公布）。该规则新增 EAR § 744.24 条款，限制向为总部（或其最终母公司总部）位于 D:5 国家组（含中国）或澳门的实体远程提供大规模算力的海外数据中心出口、再出口或境内转移先进芯片，对印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和巴西增设许可要求，收紧晶圆代工与封测推定规则，并正式废止 2025 年 1 月的 AI 扩散规则（90 FR 4544）。

narrative.en: The interim final rule extends U.S. semiconductor export controls beyond physical chip shipment into third-country cloud and data-center remote compute access, with no delayed compliance date on publication (subject to limited in-transit savings and a 90-day licensing window for certain existing data-center arrangements). Independent legal analyses by Baker McKenzie and Gibson Dunn highlight immediate customer due-diligence and licensing obligations for chip and server exporters, overseas data-center operators, cloud providers, foundries, and infrastructure lenders, while a 60-day public comment period remains open.
narrative.zhHans: 该临时最终规则将美国先进芯片出口管制从实体芯片交付延伸至第三国云端与海外数据中心的远程算力访问，且刊登当日即刻生效（仅对在途货物设有限豁免，并对部分既有数据中心安排设 90 天许可窗口）。Baker McKenzie 与 Gibson Dunn 的独立法律分析均指出，该规则对芯片与服务器出口商、海外数据中心运营方、云服务商、代工厂及基础设施融资方施加了即期尽职调查与许可义务；60 天公众评议期仍在进行中。

text.en: Effective November 19, 2026 (91 FR 74970), BIS enacted an interim final rule adding EAR § 744.24 remote-access data-center controls for Country Group D:5 and Macau entities and formally rescinding the January 2025 AI Diffusion Rule.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 19 日起生效（91 FR 74970），美国商务部 BIS 实施临时最终规则，新增 EAR § 744.24 针对 D:5 国家组与澳门实体的海外数据中心远程算力管制，并正式废止 2025 年 1 月的 AI 扩散规则。

text.en: With immediate effect and no delayed compliance date, the rule imposes binding licensing and due-diligence obligations on chip exporters, overseas data centers, and five newly covered destinations (Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Brazil), corroborated by independent legal analyses from Baker McKenzie and Gibson Dunn.
text.zhHans: 该规则即期生效且无延迟合规期，对芯片出口商、海外数据中心及新增五个目的地（印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、巴西）施加具有法律约束力的许可与尽职调查义务，获 Baker McKenzie 与 Gibson Dunn 独立法律分析印证。

description.en: Immediate-effect EAR licensing and due-diligence mandates reshape export compliance for chip/server suppliers, overseas data centers, and five newly covered countries with no general compliance delay.
description.zhHans: 即期生效的 EAR 许可与尽调要求在无普遍宽限期情况下直接改变芯片与服务器供应商、海外数据中心及五个新增许可国的合规与算力交付成本。

description.en: Legally restricts third-country remote cloud access to significant volumes of advanced U.S. AI compute for covered entities headquartered in Country Group D:5 or Macau.
description.zhHans: 从法律层面限制 D:5 国家组或澳门总部实体通过第三国海外数据中心远程获取大规模美国先进 AI 算力。
